subject: Kitchen POS terminal unable to connect to NetLink router after power reset
description: The kitchen POS terminal (MAC: 50:1A:A5:8C:3F:D2) stopped connecting to the NetLink NL-3000 v2.1 router this morning at approximately 11:15 IST after an unplanned power outage at the store. The device previously had stable connectivity on the 'ServeWell-Staff' 5GHz network. Upon restart, the terminal shows the Wi-Fi network in available networks list, but fails to authenticate with error message 'Authentication Failed - Status Code 0x00000001'. The POS terminal is running the latest firmware (v4.2.8) and the issue persists across three manual reconnection attempts. We have also cleared the stored Wi-Fi profile and re-entered the network credentials without success. The kitchen operations team has resorted to using a backup wired terminal, but this is impacting order processing efficiency during our peak lunch hours (currently 11:30-13:00). Asset details: Device IP (last known): 192.168.1.87, Router firmware last updated 2026-01-15, WPA2 Enterprise security protocol in use. The terminal is critical for kitchen order management and the current workaround is unsustainable.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and reviewed. Confirmed authentication failure with error code 0x00000001. Advised customer to power cycle the POS terminal and router completely; instructed to wait 2 minutes between power-ups. Awaiting confirmation of outcome.

Customer reports power cycle completed but authentication failure persists. Issue likely related to WPA2 Enterprise certificate mismatch post-outage or router DHCP pool exhaustion. Escalating to L2 network specialist for diagnostic checks.
